summary: Pilot-only nested-CV comparison of L1 designs: screens x feature-space variants (mains vs pairwise interactions)
reasoning: Established: main-effects logistic on top-k F features gives cv 0.564 / holdout 0.5639 (nested milestone, probe:madelon-2026-11-15-2#step-11) — estimate agrees but far below the 0.71 floor. Madelon's class function is XOR-like; linear mains cannot reach the floor, so my L1 route needs interaction features chosen on pilot alone. I will compare candidate L1 designs by repeated nested CV on data/pilot.csv ONLY (outer 2x5 folds, inner 4-fold tuning of C): screens top-k by F-score (k 10/20/30) and MI (k 20), over feature spaces mains, mains+pairwise products, binarized+pairwise sign products. Everything (k, C grid, feature space) is evaluated on pilot alone; heldout.csv is not opened. Informally, I expect mains-only variants near ~0.6 and the best interaction variant to clear 0.65 nested-cv AUC on pilot; if not, I will supersede with richer interactions. The formal expectation for this exploration run is only that it completes.
